markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (45%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Low reliability (20%) leaves Benign, InSitu, and Invasive unseparated [F1]; defer the simulated frozen-section margin call [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 45%, InSitu 32%, Benign 22%, Normal 2% (ECE 5%) | No single dominant class |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate three classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 20% reliability (flagged), 98th percentile OOD [F6] (AUROC 70%) | Suspect out-of-distribution input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Models disagree on top class |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match Invasive [F5]; 5/5 InSitu (84%–88% similarity) | All nearest neighbors are InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 8) · context · Below-typical score (+0.32); descriptive context only [F2] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.25); unreliable 0/20 spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Typical score (-0.14) lowers invasive probability [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score (-0.13) lowers invasive probability · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 3, 5) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (+0.11); unreliable 3/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.011, CI +0.002 to +0.020), supporting classifier faithfulness.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes zero (-0.009 to +0.006, unverified); this read leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- The lesion is InSitu (32%) or Benign (22%), matching all 5 nearest reference cases (InSitu, 84%–88% similarity).
- Simulated composite frozen-section artifacts caused the 20% reliability flag, warranting the drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 3**: High-risk top row (71%–99% risk) and superior/lateral margins for true stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 5, 9**: Tubules (region 5) and duct-confined atypia (region 9) to separate InSitu from invasion.
3. **Region 8**: Low-risk area (0%) scored for lymphocytes and unreliable mitoses, and check section quality.
